parameters.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_applications, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('Shortlisted','Interview','Hired')) AS shortlisted, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'Rejected') AS rejected FROM candidates;
SELECT ROUND(AVG(match_score)) AS average_match_score FROM candidate_analysis WHERE created_at::date = CURRENT_DATE;
